'''Romeo''' is a male student of the Department of Voidmatters, found at the [[Spacetrek Archive]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Romeo:''' ...The "Fundamentals of Phase Coating Theory and Techniques" exam is on Monday. Great, I haven't read a single chapter yet...
:'''Romeo:''' Then there's the "Consciousness Field Theory" exam on Tuesday. That one's okay, I guess. Just one big chapter left to go through... Not like the earlier chapters gave much away for the answers anyway.
:'''Romeo:''' Wednesday, "Roya Socio-Cultural History." I'll cram it on Wednesday morning. And there's the campus [[Fleet Snowfluff|virtual idol]] online concert this weekend, so it'll be another all-nighter...
:'''Romeo:''' Ugh, why should a student handle so much stuff?
{{Dialogue End}}
